us-20261016-news-3.title: O Comprador Tardio: Por que os Compradores de Primeira Viagem Continuam Envelhecendo Conforme Preços e Taxas Apertam a Entrada

segments.src: ## A longer road to the front door
segments.tr: ## Um caminho mais longo até a porta da frente

segments.src: For decades, buying a first home was treated as a milestone of one's twenties or early thirties.
segments.tr: Por décadas, comprar a primeira casa era tratado como um marco dos vinte e poucos ou início dos trinta anos.

segments.src: That picture no longer matches the data.
segments.tr: Essa imagem não corresponde mais aos dados.

segments.src: According to recent figures from the National Association of Realtors, the typical first-time buyer in the United States is now around 38 years old, a record high and a sharp rise from the low thirties that was the norm a generation ago.
segments.tr: De acordo com números recentes da Associação Nacional de Corretores de Imóveis, o comprador típico de primeira viagem nos Estados Unidos tem agora cerca de 38 anos, um recorde histórico e um aumento acentuado em relação ao início dos trinta anos que era a norma uma geração atrás.

segments.src: At the same time, first-time buyers account for a smaller share of all home purchases than at any point in the survey's history, at roughly a quarter of transactions in recent annual readings, compared with about four in ten over the long-run average.
segments.tr: Ao mesmo tempo, os compradores de primeira viagem respondem por uma fatia menor de todas as compras de imóveis do que em qualquer momento na história da pesquisa, representando cerca de um quarto das transações nas leituras anuais recentes, comparado a cerca de quatro em cada dez na média de longo prazo.

segments.src: Taken together, these numbers describe a market in which getting onto the property ladder takes longer, and in which fewer people manage it in any given year.
segments.tr: Considerados em conjunto, esses números descrevem um mercado em que entrar na escada imobiliária leva mais tempo, e em que menos pessoas conseguem isso em um determinado ano.

segments.src: ## Three pressures at once
segments.tr: ## Três pressões ao mesmo tiempo

segments.src: No single factor explains the shift.
segments.tr: Nenhum fator isolado explica a mudança.

segments.src: Instead, three pressures have stacked on top of one another.
segments.tr: Em vez disso, três pressões se acumularam umas sobre as outras.

segments.src: **High prices.** Home values rose sharply in the years after 2020 and have largely held their gains.
segments.tr: **Preços altos.** Os valores dos imóveis subiram acentuadamente nos anos seguintes a 2020 e mantiveram amplamente seus ganhos.

segments.src: The national median existing-home price has climbed well above $400,000, and in many metropolitan areas it is far higher.
segments.tr: O preço mediano nacional de casas existentes subiu bem acima de $400,000, e em muitas áreas metropolitanas é muito maior.

segments.src: Incomes have grown, but not at the same pace, which stretches the number of years a household needs to save for a down payment.
segments.tr: A renda cresceu, mas não no mesmo ritmo, o que estende o número de anos que uma família precisa economizar para dar uma entrada.

segments.src: **Elevated mortgage rates.** The era of ultra-low borrowing costs is over.
segments.tr: **Taxas de hipoteca elevadas.** A era dos custos de empréstimo ultrabaixos acabou.

segments.src: With 30-year fixed rates well above the levels seen in 2020 and 2021, the monthly payment on the same house is substantially larger.
segments.tr: Com taxas fixas de 30 anos bem acima dos níveis vistos em 2020 e 2021, o pagamento mensal da mesma casa é substancialmente maior.

segments.src: A buyer borrowing $350,000 at 7 percent pays several hundred dollars more each month than one borrowing the same amount at 4 percent, before taxes and insurance.
segments.tr: Um comprador que empresta $350,000 a 7 por cento paga várias centenas de dólares a mais a cada mês do que alguém que empresta o mesmo valor a 4 por cento, antes de impostos e seguros.

segments.src: **Thin inventory.** Many existing owners locked in low rates and are reluctant to sell and take on a new, more expensive loan.
segments.tr: **Inventário escasso.** Muitos proprietários existentes travaram taxas baixas e relutam em vender e assumir um empréstimo novo e mais caro.

segments.src: That "lock-in effect" has kept the supply of homes for sale tight, especially in the entry-level segment where first-time buyers tend to shop.
segments.tr: Esse "efeito de travessia" manteve a oferta de casas para venda apertada, especialmente no segmento de entrada onde os compradores de primeira viagem tendem a procurar.

segments.src: Fewer listings mean more competition and less room to negotiate.
segments.tr: Menos anúncios significam mais concorrência e menos margem para negociação.

segments.src: ## Who is getting in, and how
segments.tr: ## Quem está entrando e como

segments.src: The buyers who do succeed often share certain characteristics.
segments.tr: Os compradores que de fato têm sucesso frequentemente compartilham certas características.

segments.src: They are more likely to be married or partnered with two incomes, to have received help with the down payment from family, or to live in lower-cost regions.
segments.tr: Eles têm mais probabilidade de ser casados ou ter um parceiro com duas rendas, de terem recebido ajuda com a entrada da família, ou de viver em regiões de menor custo.

segments.src: Single buyers and renters in expensive coastal cities face the steepest climb.
segments.tr: Compradores sozinhos e inquilinos em cidades costeiras caras enfrentam a subida mais íngreme.

segments.src: Some households adapt by changing what they buy rather than whether they buy.
segments.tr: Algumas famílias se adaptam mudando o que compram em vez de se compram.

segments.src: Common strategies include:
segments.tr: As estratégias comuns incluem:

segments.src: - Choosing smaller homes, condominiums or townhouses over single-family houses
segments.tr: - Escolher casas menores, condomínios ou sobrados em vez de casas unifamiliares

segments.src: - Moving to more affordable metro areas or commuter towns
segments.tr: - Mudar-se para áreas metropolitanas mais acessíveis ou cidades dormitório

segments.src: - Pooling resources with a partner, relative or friend
segments.tr: - Juntar recursos com um parceiro, parente ou amigo

segments.src: - Using down-payment assistance programs offered by states and localities
segments.tr: - Usar programas de assistência para entrada oferecidos por estados e localidades

segments.src: - Renting longer while building savings and improving credit
segments.tr: - Alugar por mais tempo enquanto constroem economias e melhoram o crédito

segments.src: ## The wider consequences
segments.tr: ## As consequências mais amplas

segments.src: A later start has effects beyond the housing market.
segments.tr: Um início mais tarde tem efeitos além do mercado imobiliário.

segments.src: Homeownership is the primary way most American households build wealth, and equity accumulates over time.
segments.tr: A propriedade da casa própria é a principal maneira pela qual a maioria das famílias americanas constrói riqueza, e o patrimônio líquido se acumula ao longo do tempo.

segments.src: A buyer who enters at 38 rather than 28 has fewer years to pay down a mortgage before retirement and fewer years of appreciation to benefit from.
segments.tr: Um comprador que entra aos 38 anos em vez de aos 28 tem menos anos para pagar uma hipoteca antes da aposentadoria e menos anos de valorização para se beneficiar.

segments.src: Economists also point to links with household formation, family size and mobility, since people tend to delay other major decisions when housing is out of reach.
segments.tr: Economistas também apontam para ligações com a formação de famílias, tamanho da família e mobilidade, já que as pessoas tendem a adiar outras decisões importantes quando a moradia está fora de alcance.

segments.src: There is also a generational dimension.
segments.tr: Há também uma dimensão geracional.

segments.src: Older buyers who already own are, in many cases, staying in their homes longer, which reduces turnover and compounds the supply problem for younger households.
segments.tr: Compradores mais velhos que já possuem casa estão, em muitos casos, ficando em suas casas por mais tempo, o que reduz a rotatividade e agrava o problema de oferta para as famílias mais jovens.

segments.src: ## What could change the picture
segments.tr: ## O que poderia mudar o cenário

segments.src: Analysts generally see no quick fix.
segments.tr: Os analistas geralmente não veem uma solução rápida.

segments.src: Lower mortgage rates would help payments but could also unlock demand faster than supply can respond, putting upward pressure on prices.
segments.tr: Taxas de hipoteca mais baixas ajudariam nos pagamentos, mas também poderiam liberar a demanda mais rápido do que a oferta pode responder, exercendo pressão de alta sobre os preços.

segments.src: Increasing construction, particularly of modest, lower-priced homes, is widely cited as the most durable remedy, though zoning rules, labor shortages and building costs slow that response.
segments.tr: Aumentar a construção, particularmente de casas modestas e de menor preço, é amplamente citado como o remédio mais durável, embora regras de zoneamento, escassez de mão de obra e custos de construção tornem essa resposta lenta.

segments.src: For prospective buyers, the practical takeaway is to plan around a longer timeline: build savings, understand the full monthly cost of ownership, compare programs available locally, and be realistic about the trade-offs between location, size and price.
segments.tr: Para potenciais compradores, a conclusão prática é planejar em torno de um cronograma mais longo: construir economias, entender o custo mensal total da propriedade, comparar os programas disponíveis localmente e ser realista sobre as concessões entre localização, tamanho e preço.

segments.tr: *Este artigo é apenas para fins informativos gerais e não constitui aconselhamento financeiro ou imobiliário.

segments.tr: Os números são aproximados e podem variar por fonte e período de relatório.*

us-20261016-news-2.title: Por que a Noite da Eleição Raramente Termina na Noite da Eleição: Como os Votos pelo Correio São Contados, Estado por Estado

segments.src: Every election cycle, viewers watch the clock on election night and wonder why some races are called within minutes of the polls closing while others stay open for days.
segments.tr: Every election cycle, viewers watch the clock on election night and wonder why some races are called within minutes of the polls closing while others stay open for days.

segments.src: The explanation is usually not fraud, incompetence, or mystery.
segments.tr: The explanation is usually not fraud, incompetence, or mystery.

segments.src: It is a patchwork of state laws that govern when mail ballots can be processed, how long they can arrive, and when results become official.
segments.tr: It is a patchwork of state laws that govern when mail ballots can be processed, how long they can arrive, and when results become official.

segments.src: ## "Counting" Is Several Different Steps
segments.tr: ## "Counting" Is Several Different Steps

segments.src: Before comparing states, it helps to separate the steps that often get lumped together as "counting."
segments.tr: Before comparing states, it helps to separate the steps that often get lumped together as "counting."

segments.src: - **Receipt:** The election office receives the returned ballot envelope.
segments.tr: - **Receipt:** The election office receives the returned ballot envelope.

segments.src: - **Verification:** Staff check the voter's signature or other identifying information, confirm the voter is eligible, and make sure the voter has not already voted.
segments.tr: - **Verification:** Staff check the voter's signature or other identifying information, confirm the voter is eligible, and make sure the voter has not already voted.

segments.src: - **Processing (sometimes called pre-canvassing):** Envelopes are opened, ballots are removed and flattened, and they are prepared for scanning. In many places this can happen before Election Day.
segments.tr: - **Processing (sometimes called pre-canvassing):** Envelopes are opened, ballots are removed and flattened, and they are prepared for scanning. In many places this can happen before Election Day.

segments.src: - **Tabulation:** Ballots are run through scanners and the votes are added to the totals. Many states restrict when tabulation may begin, and most do not publish results until polls close.
segments.tr: - **Tabulation:** Ballots are run through scanners and the votes are added to the totals. Many states restrict when tabulation may begin, and most do not publish results until polls close.

segments.src: - **Canvass and certification:** Officials reconcile the numbers, resolve problem ballots, run required audits, and formally certify the final results.
segments.tr: - **Canvass and certification:** Officials reconcile the numbers, resolve problem ballots, run required audits, and formally certify the final results.

segments.src: A state may allow early processing but not early tabulation, or allow both.
segments.tr: A state may allow early processing but not early tabulation, or allow both.

segments.src: Each variation changes how quickly a large pile of mail ballots turns into reported votes.
segments.tr: Each variation changes how quickly a large pile of mail ballots turns into reported votes.

segments.src: ## Three Rules That Shape the Timeline
segments.tr: ## Three Rules That Shape the Timeline

segments.src: ### 1. When Can Officials Start Processing?
segments.tr: ### 1. When Can Officials Start Processing?

segments.src: Some states let election workers begin opening and preparing mail ballots weeks ahead of Election Day, so that on election night they only need to scan and report.
segments.tr: Some states let election workers begin opening and preparing mail ballots weeks ahead of Election Day, so that on election night they only need to scan and report.

segments.src: Others restrict processing until Election Day itself, or even until the polls close.
segments.tr: Others restrict processing until Election Day itself, or even until the polls close.

segments.src: In those states, a large volume of mail ballots must be handled by the same staff who are also running in-person voting, which naturally slows the count.
segments.tr: In those states, a large volume of mail ballots must be handled by the same staff who are also running in-person voting, which naturally slows the count.

segments.src: ### 2. How Long Can Ballots Arrive After Election Day?
segments.tr: ### 2. How Long Can Ballots Arrive After Election Day?

segments.src: States also differ on receipt deadlines.
segments.tr: States also differ on receipt deadlines.

segments.src: Broadly, there are two approaches:
segments.tr: Broadly, there are two approaches:

segments.src: - **Received by Election Day:** The ballot must be in the election office by the time polls close. Anything arriving later is not counted.
segments.tr: - **Received by Election Day:** The ballot must be in the election office by the time polls close. Anything arriving later is not counted.

segments.src: - **Postmarked by Election Day:** The ballot must be mailed on or before Election Day, and it can still be counted if it arrives within a set window afterward, which varies by state from a few days to about a week or more.
segments.tr: - **Postmarked by Election Day:** The ballot must be mailed on or before Election Day, and it can still be counted if it arrives within a set window afterward, which varies by state from a few days to about a week or more.

segments.src: Military and overseas voters often have their own, longer deadlines under federal and state law.
segments.tr: Military and overseas voters often have their own, longer deadlines under federal and state law.

segments.src: Receipt rules have also been the subject of litigation and legislative changes in recent years, so the details can differ from one election to the next.
segments.tr: Receipt rules have also been the subject of litigation and legislative changes in recent years, so the details can differ from one election to the next.

segments.src: ### 3. When Are Results Certified?
segments.tr: ### 3. When Are Results Certified?

segments.src: Election night totals are always unofficial.
segments.tr: Election night totals are always unofficial.

segments.src: Counties typically certify first, then the state.
segments.tr: Counties typically certify first, then the state.

segments.src: Certification deadlines range from a matter of days to several weeks, depending on the state and the type of contest.
segments.tr: Certification deadlines range from a matter of days to several weeks, depending on the state and the type of contest.

segments.src: This period includes reviewing provisional ballots, giving voters time to fix signature or paperwork problems (known as "curing"), and conducting audits or recounts when margins fall within legal thresholds.
segments.tr: This period includes reviewing provisional ballots, giving voters time to fix signature or paperwork problems (known as "curing"), and conducting audits or recounts when margins fall within legal thresholds.

segments.src: ## Why Some Races Are Called Fast
segments.tr: ## Why Some Races Are Called Fast

segments.src: Media organizations and decision desks do not wait for every ballot.
segments.tr: Media organizations and decision desks do not wait for every ballot.

segments.src: They call a race when the remaining uncounted votes cannot realistically change the outcome.
segments.tr: They call a race when the remaining uncounted votes cannot realistically change the outcome.

segments.src: A race can be called quickly when:
segments.tr: A race can be called quickly when:

segments.src: - the margin is wide enough that outstanding ballots are mathematically irrelevant;
segments.tr: - the margin is wide enough that outstanding ballots are mathematically irrelevant;

segments.src: - the state processes mail ballots early and reports a large share of them soon after polls close;
segments.tr: - the state processes mail ballots early and reports a large share of them soon after polls close;

segments.src: - the number of late-arriving ballots is small.
segments.tr: - the number of late-arriving ballots is small.

segments.src: States with a long tradition of early processing and high-volume mail voting often report most of their vote on election night.
segments.tr: States with a long tradition of early processing and high-volume mail voting often report most of their vote on election night.

segments.src: Races in these states can be called within hours.
segments.tr: Races in these states can be called within hours.

segments.src: ## Why Others Take Days
segments.tr: ## Why Others Take Days

segments.src: A race may stay uncalled when:
segments.tr: A race may stay uncalled when:

segments.src: - the margin is narrow, so even a modest number of outstanding ballots could matter;
segments.tr: - the margin is narrow, so even a modest number of outstanding ballots could matter;

segments.src: - a large share of ballots are mail ballots that could not be processed until Election Day;
segments.tr: - a large share of ballots are mail ballots that could not be processed until Election Day;

segments.src: - the state accepts ballots that arrive after Election Day;
segments.tr: - the state accepts ballots that arrive after Election Day;

segments.src: - signature-cure periods are still running;
segments.tr: - signature-cure periods are still running;

segments.src: - many provisional ballots need to be reviewed.
segments.tr: - many provisional ballots need to be reviewed.

segments.src: In some places, the order in which ballots are counted can also create a temporary swing.
segments.tr: In some places, the order in which ballots are counted can also create a temporary swing.

segments.src: If in-person votes are reported first, early totals may lean one way and shift as mail ballots are added.
segments.tr: If in-person votes are reported first, early totals may lean one way and shift as mail ballots are added.

segments.src: If mail ballots are reported first, the pattern can reverse.
segments.tr: If mail ballots are reported first, the pattern can reverse.

segments.src: Neither pattern signals a problem.
segments.tr: Neither pattern signals a problem.

segments.src: It reflects which batches of ballots were reported when, and it is often described as a "red shift" or "blue shift" depending on the state.
segments.tr: It reflects which batches of ballots were reported when, and it is often described as a "red shift" or "blue shift" depending on the state.

segments.src: The final tally is what counts.
segments.tr: The final tally is what counts.

segments.src: ## A Simple State-by-State Illustration
segments.tr: ## A Simple State-by-State Illustration

segments.src: Without getting lost in the fine print, states tend to fall into broad groups:
segments.tr: Without getting lost in the fine print, states tend to fall into broad groups:

segments.src: - **Early processors with quick reporting:** States that allow processing well before Election Day, and that mostly require ballots to be received by Election Day, tend to report the bulk of results on election night.
segments.tr: - **Early processors with quick reporting:** States that allow processing well before Election Day, and that mostly require ballots to be received by Election Day, tend to report the bulk of results on election night.

segments.src: - **Universal mail states with grace periods:** States that mail a ballot to every registered voter and accept ballots postmarked by Election Day often report a large first batch on election night, then release additional batches over the following days as late-arriving ballots are verified and counted.
segments.tr: - **Universal mail states with grace periods:** States that mail a ballot to every registered voter and accept ballots postmarked by Election Day often report a large first batch on election night, then release additional batches over the following days as late-arriving ballots are verified and counted.

segments.src: - **Late processors:** States that historically restricted processing until Election Day have often needed more time, particularly when mail voting surged.
segments.tr: - **Late processors:** States that historically restricted processing until Election Day have often needed more time, particularly when mail voting surged.

segments.src: Individual states change their laws frequently, so the best source for current rules is always your state or county election office.
segments.tr: Individual states change their laws frequently, so the best source for current rules is always your state or county election office.

segments.src: ## What Voters Can Do
segments.tr: ## What Voters Can Do

segments.src: Understanding the timeline can make the days after an election less stressful.
segments.tr: Understanding the timeline can make the days after an election less stressful.

segments.src: - **Return your ballot early.** This reduces the chance of delays and leaves time to fix any problems.
segments.tr: - **Return your ballot early.** This reduces the chance of delays and leaves time to fix any problems.

segments.src: - **Track your ballot.** Many states offer online ballot tracking that shows when your ballot was received and accepted.
segments.tr: - **Track your ballot.** Many states offer online ballot tracking that shows when your ballot was received and accepted.

segments.src: - **Respond to cure notices promptly.** If your signature is questioned, you are usually given a short window to confirm your ballot.
segments.tr: - **Respond to cure notices promptly.** If your signature is questioned, you are usually given a short window to confirm your ballot.

segments.src: - **Check official sources.** County and state election websites publish updates, the schedule for results, and certification dates.
segments.tr: - **Check official sources.** County and state election websites publish updates, the schedule for results, and certification dates.

segments.src: - **Treat election night numbers as preliminary.** Unofficial results can change as additional ballots are counted.
segments.tr: - **Treat election night numbers as preliminary.** Unofficial results can change as additional ballots are counted.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## The Bottom Line

segments.src: A slow count is not the same as a flawed count.
segments.tr: A slow count is not the same as a flawed count.

segments.src: When it takes several days to know who won, it often means the system is doing what the law requires: verifying each ballot, giving eligible voters the full window the state allows, and finishing the canvass before certifying.
segments.tr: When it takes several days to know who won, it often means the system is doing what the law requires: verifying each ballot, giving eligible voters the full window the state allows, and finishing the canvass before certifying.

segments.src: Knowing the rules in your state turns a confusing wait into a predictable process.
segments.tr: Knowing the rules in your state turns a confusing wait into a predictable process.

segments.tr: Election laws vary and change; consult your state or local election office for current deadlines and procedures.*

us-20261016-news-1.title: O Recibo de Gastos com IA: O que os Lucros da Big Tech na Próxima Semana Revelarão sobre uma Aposta de Um Trilhão de Dólares

segments.src: Over the next several days, some of the largest technology companies in the world will open their books for the latest quarter.
segments.tr: Nos próximos dias, algumas das maiores empresas de tecnologia do mundo abrirão seus livros para o trimestre mais recente.

segments.src: Revenue and profit will get the headlines, as they always do.
segments.tr: Receita e lucro ocuparão as manchetes, como sempre fazem.

segments.src: But this earnings season, the number many investors care about most sits a little further down the page: **how much these companies are spending on chips and data centers, and whether that spending is beginning to pay off.**
segments.tr: Mas nesta temporada de balanços, o número com o qual muitos investidores se importam mais está um pouco mais abaixo na página: **quanto essas empresas estão gastando em chips e data centers, e se esse gasto está começando a dar resultado.**

segments.src: That question matters well beyond Wall Street.
segments.tr: Essa pergunta importa muito além de Wall Street.

segments.src: The answer can influence tech stock prices, the value of retirement accounts that hold them, and the pace of the broader economy.
segments.tr: A resposta pode influenciar os preços das ações de tecnologia, o valor das contas de aposentadoria que as possuem e o ritmo da economia em geral.

segments.src: ## Why this earnings season is different
segments.tr: ## Por que esta temporada de balanços é diferente

segments.src: For years, big tech earnings followed a familiar script: advertising, cloud subscriptions, devices and software.
segments.tr: Por anos, os lucros das grandes empresas de tecnologia seguiram um roteiro familiar: publicidade, assinaturas de nuvem, dispositivos e software.

segments.src: Since the rise of generative artificial intelligence, a new line item has taken center stage.
segments.tr: Desde o surgimento da inteligência artificial generativa, um novo item de linha assumiu o centro das atenções.

segments.src: **Capital expenditures**, often shortened to "capex," refers to money spent on long-lived assets such as data centers, servers, networking gear and specialized AI chips.
segments.tr: **Despesas de capital**, frequentemente abreviadas como "capex", referem-se ao dinheiro gasto em ativos de longa duração, como data centers, servidores, equipamentos de rede e chips de IA especializados.

segments.src: Across the industry, the combined capex plans of the largest cloud and platform companies have climbed to levels that analysts often describe in the hundreds of billions of dollars per year.
segments.tr: Em todo o setor, os planos combinados de capex das maiores empresas de nuvem e plataformas subiram a níveis que os analistas frequentemente descrevem na casa das centenas de bilhões de dólares por ano.

segments.src: Taken together with commitments over several years, the total is frequently framed as a trillion-dollar bet that AI will become a core part of how people and businesses work.
segments.tr: Tomado em conjunto com compromissos ao longo de vários anos, o total é frequentemente enquadrado como uma aposta de um trilhão de dólares de que a IA se tornará uma parte central de como as pessoas e as empresas trabalham.

segments.src: A bet that large raises an obvious question: where is the return?
segments.tr: Uma aposta tão grande levanta uma pergunta óbvia: onde está o retorno?

segments.src: ## What investors will be watching
segments.tr: ## O que os investidores estarão observando

segments.src: Analysts and investors are likely to focus on a handful of signals:
segments.tr: Analistas e investidores provavelmente focarão em um punhado de sinais:

segments.src: - **Capex guidance.** Did companies raise, hold or trim their spending plans for the coming year? A higher number can signal confidence in demand, but it can also raise worries about profit margins.
segments.tr: - **Orientação de capex.** As empresas aumentaram, mantiveram ou reduziram seus planos de gastos para o próximo ano? Um número maior pode sinalizar confiança na demanda, mas também pode aumentar as preocupações sobre margens de lucro.

segments.src: - **Cloud growth.** Cloud divisions are where much of the AI demand shows up first. Faster growth, and commentary about backlogs of customer commitments, would suggest the infrastructure is being put to use.
segments.tr: - **Crescimento da nuvem.** As divisões de nuvem são onde grande parte da demanda de IA aparece primeiro. Um crescimento mais rápido e comentários sobre atrasos nos compromissos dos clientes sugerem que a infraestrutura está sendo colocada em uso.

segments.src: - **Capacity constraints.** Executives often say demand exceeds the computing capacity they can supply. If that remains true, it supports the case for continued building. If it fades, the tone may change.
segments.tr: - **Restrições de capacidade.** Os executivos frequentemente dizem que a demanda excede a capacidade de computação que podem fornecer. Se isso continuar verdade, sustenta o argumento para a construção contínua. Se enfraquecer, o tom pode mudar.

segments.src: - **Margins and depreciation.** Servers and chips lose value over time, and that cost flows through the income statement as depreciation. Rising depreciation can weigh on profits even when revenue is growing.
segments.tr: - **Margens e depreciação.** Servidores e chips perdem valor ao longo do tempo, e esse custo flui através da demonstração de resultados como depreciação. O aumento da depreciação pode pesar sobre os lucros, mesmo quando a receita está crescendo.

segments.src: - **AI revenue disclosure.** Some companies share figures on AI-related products or customer usage. Any new detail on how many people and businesses are paying for these tools will be closely scrutinized.
segments.tr: - **Divulgação de receita de IA.** Algumas empresas compartilham números sobre produtos relacionados à IA ou uso de clientes. Qualquer detalhe novo sobre quantas pessoas e empresas estão pagando por essas ferramentas será escrutinado de perto.

segments.src: - **Free cash flow.** When spending rises quickly, the cash left over after investment can shrink. Investors will check whether companies are funding the buildout from operations or leaning more on debt.
segments.tr: - **Fluxo de caixa livre.** Quando os gastos aumentam rapidamente, o dinheiro restante após o investimento pode encolher. Os investidores verificarão se as empresas estão financianado a expansão a partir das operações ou recorrendo mais a dívidas.

segments.src: ## The case for patience
segments.tr: ## O argumento para a paciência

segments.src: Supporters of the spending argue that large infrastructure cycles take time to mature.
segments.tr: Os defensores dos gastos argumentam que grandes ciclos de infraestrutura levam tempo para amadurecer.

segments.src: Railroads, electric grids and the early internet all required heavy upfront investment before their economic benefits became clear.
segments.tr: Ferrovias, redes elétricas e a internet inicial exigiram fortes investimentos iniciais antes que seus benefícios econômicos se tornassem claros.

segments.src: In this view, the companies building AI capacity today are positioning for a long period of growth, and falling behind could be costlier than overbuilding.
segments.tr: Sob essa ótica, as empresas que constroem capacidade de IA hoje estão se posicionando para um longo período de crescimento, e ficar para trás pode ser mais custoso do que construir em excesso.

segments.src: There is also evidence that businesses are experimenting widely with AI for coding assistance, customer service, document analysis and research.
segments.tr: Há também evidências de que as empresas estão experimentando amplamente com IA para assistência de codificação, atendimento ao cliente, análise de documentos e pesquisa.

segments.src: If those pilots turn into everyday workflows, demand for computing power could keep rising.
segments.tr: Se esses pilotos se transformarem em fluxos de trabalho cotidianos, a demanda por poder computacional poderá continuar subindo.

segments.src: ## The case for caution
segments.tr: ## O argumento para a cautela

segments.src: Skeptics point out that spending is arriving faster than proven revenue.
segments.tr: Os céticos apontam que os gastos estão chegando mais rápido do que a receita comprovada.

segments.src: They note that some of the demand comes from a relatively small group of AI developers and that companies are, in part, selling to customers they also fund.
segments.tr: Eles observam que parte da demanda vem de um grupo relativamente pequeno de desenvolvedores de IA e que as empresas estão, em parte, vendendo para clientes que também financiam.

segments.src: They also ask whether the pace of chip upgrades will make today's hardware obsolete sooner than expected, shortening the period in which it can earn a return.
segments.tr: Eles também perguntam se o ritmo das atualizações de chips tornará o hardware de hoje obsoleto mais rápido do que o esperado, encurtando o período em que ele pode gerar um retorno.

segments.src: Power supply is another constraint.
segments.tr: O fornecimento de energia é outra restrição.

segments.src: Data centers need large amounts of electricity, and delays in securing grid connections or equipment can slow projects and raise costs.
segments.tr: Data centers precisam de grandes quantidades de eletricidade, e atrasos na garantia de conexões à rede elétrica ou equipamentos podem retardar projetos e aumentar custos.

segments.src: History offers a cautionary note: periods of enthusiastic building have sometimes been followed by corrections when expectations ran ahead of results.
segments.tr: A história oferece uma nota de cautela: períodos de construção entusiástica foram às vezes seguidos por correções quando as expectativas correram à frente dos resultados.

segments.src: Whether this cycle follows that path is exactly what investors are trying to judge.
segments.tr: Se este ciclo segue esse caminho é exatamente o que os investidores estão tentando julgar.

segments.src: ## Why it matters to everyday households
segments.tr: ## Por que isso importa para as famílias comuns

segments.src: Many people own these companies without realizing it.
segments.tr: Muitas pessoas possuem essas empresas sem perceber.

segments.src: Large technology firms make up a significant share of popular index funds, and those funds sit inside 401(k)s, IRAs and target-date retirement portfolios.
segments.tr: Grandes empresas de tecnologia compõem uma fatia significativa de fundos de índice populares, e esses fundos ficam dentro de contas 401(k), IRAs e portfólios de aposentadoria de data-alvo.

segments.src: When a handful of companies move sharply, broad market indexes can move with them.
segments.tr: Quando um punhado de empresas se move fortemente, os índices amplos de mercado podem se mover com elas.

segments.src: The effects reach further than portfolios:
segments.tr: Os efeitos alcançam mais do que portfólios:

segments.src: - **Jobs and construction.** Data center projects support work in construction, electrical equipment and energy.
segments.tr: - **Empregos e construção.** Projetos de data centers apoiam trabalhos em construção, equipamentos elétricos e energia.

segments.src: - **Utilities and electricity demand.** Growing computing needs are influencing power planning in some regions.
segments.tr: - **Utilidades e demanda de eletricidade.** Necessidades crescentes de computação estão influenciando o planejamento de energia em algumas regiões.

segments.src: - **Business investment.** AI-related spending has become a noticeable contributor to overall corporate investment in the economy.
segments.tr: - **Investimento empresarial.** Gastos relacionados à IA tornaram-se um contribuidor perceptível para o investimento corporativo geral na economia.

segments.src: - **Consumer products.** The tools built on this infrastructure are showing up in search, productivity software, phones and customer service.
segments.tr: - **Produtos de consumo.** As ferramentas construídas sobre esta infraestrutura estão aparecendo em buscas, software de produtividade, telefones e atendimento ao cliente.

segments.src: ## How to read the results
segments.tr: ## Como ler os resultados

segments.src: A few practical tips for following the news without getting lost in the noise:
segments.tr: Algumas dicas práticas para acompanhar as notícias sem se perder no ruído:

segments.src: 1. **Compare spending to growth.** A big capex number means little without context. Look at it alongside cloud revenue growth and operating margins.
segments.tr: 1. **Compare gastos com crescimento.** Um número grande de capex significa pouco sem contexto. Olhe para ele ao lado do crescimento da receita de nuvem e das margens operacionais.

segments.src: 2. **Listen to the tone on the call.** Language about demand, capacity and timelines often tells you more than a single figure.
segments.tr: 2. **Ouça o tom na teleconferência.** A linguagem sobre demanda, capacidade e cronogramas frequentemente lhe diz mais do que uma única figura.

segments.src: 3. **Remember that one quarter is a snapshot.** Infrastructure returns play out over years, and stock reactions on earnings day can be short-lived.
segments.tr: 3. **Lembre-se de que um trimestre é um retrato.** Os retornos de infraestrutura se desenrolam ao longo de anos, e as reações das ações no dia dos lucros podem ser de curta duração.

segments.src: 4. **Mind your own concentration.** If much of your savings is tied to a few large technology names, it may be worth understanding how your funds are weighted.
segments.tr: 4. **Preste atenção à sua própria concentração.** Se grande parte de sua poupança está atada a alguns grandes nomes de tecnologia, pode valer a pena entender como seus fundos estão ponderados.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## A conclusão

segments.src: Next week's reports will not settle the debate over whether the AI buildout is a visionary investment or an overreach.
segments.tr: Os relatórios da próxima semana não resolverão o debate sobre se a expansão da IA é um investimento visionário ou um exagero.

segments.src: But they will add fresh evidence on both sides: how fast the spending is growing, how much customers are paying for it, and how comfortably companies can afford it.
segments.tr: Mas eles adicionarão novas evidências em ambos os lados: quão rápido os gastos estão crescendo, quanto os clientes estão pagando por isso e com que conforto as empresas podem arcar com isso.

segments.src: For investors and savers alike, the receipt for the AI boom is starting to come into view.
segments.tr: Para investidores e poupadores igualmente, o recibo do boom da IA está começando a entrar em foco.

segments.src: How it reads may shape markets well into the new year.
segments.tr: Como ele é lido pode moldar os mercados bem adentrando o ano novo.

segments.tr: *Este artigo é para informação geral e não constitui consultoria de investimento.

segments.tr: As condições de mercado mudam rapidamente;considere consultar um profissional financeiro qualificado sobre sua própria situação.*

us-20261016-intro-logistics-13.title: [Logistics 101 #13] Seu pacote se move duas vezes. Os dados dele se movem cinquenta vezes.

segments.src: > Warehouses and trucks move boxes, but software decides which box, which truck, and when — and that software is really three systems (WMS, TMS, ERP) stitched together by scans.
segments.tr: > Armazéns e caminhões movem caixas, mas é o software que decide qual caixa, qual caminhão e quando, e esse software são, na verdade, três sistemas (WMS, TMS, ERP) costurados por leituras de código de barras.

segments.src: ## Today's Concept
segments.tr: ## Conceito de hoje

segments.src: Picture the last thing you ordered online.
segments.tr: Imagine a última coisa que você comprou online.

segments.src: Physically, it made maybe four moves: shelf to tote, tote to box, box to trailer, trailer to your porch.
segments.tr: Fisicamente, ela fez talvez quatro movimentos: da prateleira para a caixa de separação, da caixa de separação para a embalagem, da embalagem para o caminhão e do caminhão para a sua porta.

segments.src: Digitally, it triggered dozens of transactions — an order record, an inventory allocation, a pick task, a carton label, a rate quote, a load tender, six or seven tracking scans, an invoice.
segments.tr: Digitalmente, disparou dezenas de transações: um registro do pedido, uma alocação de estoque, uma tarefa de separação, uma etiqueta da caixa, uma cotação de frete, uma oferta de carga para a transportadora, seis ou sete leituras de rastreamento e uma fatura.

segments.src: That digital layer is the **logistics information system**, and in most companies it's not one product.
segments.tr: Essa camada digital é o **sistema de informação logística**, e na maioria das empresas ele não é um produto só.

segments.src: It's three, each with its own job:
segments.tr: São três, cada um com sua função:

segments.src: **ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning)** is the system of record — the company's books.
segments.tr: **ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning)** é o sistema de registro, os livros da empresa.

segments.src: It holds the customer order, the purchase order, the item master, the price, the general ledger.
segments.tr: Ele guarda o pedido do cliente, o pedido de compra, o cadastro de itens, o preço e o razão contábil.

segments.src: SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, Microsoft Dynamics.
segments.tr: SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, Microsoft Dynamics.

segments.src: The ERP knows *what* was promised to whom, but it has almost no idea where any physical carton is sitting right now.
segments.tr: O ERP sabe *o que* foi prometido a quem, mas quase não sabe onde está nenhuma caixa física neste momento.

segments.src: **WMS (Warehouse Management System)** runs everything inside the four walls.
segments.tr: **WMS (Warehouse Management System)** controla tudo dentro das quatro paredes.

segments.src: It directs receiving, decides where to putaway a pallet (slotting), generates pick tasks in an efficient walk path, controls packing and cartonization, manages cycle counts, and produces the shipping label.
segments.tr: Ele direciona o recebimento, decide onde armazenar um palete (slotting), gera tarefas de separação com um percurso eficiente, controla a embalagem e o encaixotamento, gerencia as contagens cíclicas e emite a etiqueta de envio.

segments.src: Manhattan Associates, Blue Yonder, Körber.
segments.tr: Manhattan Associates, Blue Yonder, Körber.

segments.src: The WMS is the only system that truly knows that SKU 44821 is in aisle 12, bin B, quantity 63.
segments.tr: O WMS é o único sistema que realmente sabe que o SKU 44821 está no corredor 12, posição B, quantidade 63.

segments.src: **TMS (Transportation Management System)** takes over once freight leaves the dock — and often before.
segments.tr: **TMS (Transportation Management System)** assume quando a carga deixa a doca, e muitas vezes antes disso.

segments.src: It rates and compares carriers, picks the mode (parcel, LTL, truckload, intermodal), consolidates small orders into one load, tenders that load to a carrier, tracks it, and audits the freight bill against the contracted rate.
segments.tr: Ele avalia e compara transportadoras, escolhe o modal (encomenda, LTL, carga fechada, intermodal), consolida pequenos pedidos em uma só carga, oferece essa carga a uma transportadora, acompanha o transporte e audita a fatura de frete contra a tarifa contratada.

segments.src: Overpaying carriers is shockingly common without one; freight audit alone often pays for the software.
segments.tr: Pagar a mais às transportadoras é surpreendentemente comum sem um TMS; a auditoria de frete sozinha muitas vezes paga o software.

segments.src: The hard part isn't any single system.
segments.tr: A parte difícil não é nenhum sistema isoladamente.

segments.src: It's **the seams**.
segments.tr: São **as junções**.

segments.src: In the U.S., those seams are usually crossed one of two ways: **EDI**, the decades-old transaction-set standard (a 940 tells the warehouse to ship, a 945 confirms it shipped, a 204 tenders a load to a trucker, a 214 sends status updates back, an 856 is the advance ship notice that tells the retailer what's on the truck), or modern **APIs**, which do the same thing in near real time.
segments.tr: Nos EUA, essas junções costumam ser atravessadas de um de dois jeitos: **EDI**, o padrão de conjuntos de transações com décadas de uso (um 940 instrui o armazém a expedir, um 945 confirma a expedição, um 204 oferece uma carga a um transportador rodoviário, um 214 envia de volta as atualizações de status e um 856 é o aviso prévio de expedição (ASN) que informa ao varejista o que está no caminhão), ou **APIs** modernas, que fazem o mesmo em tempo quase real.

segments.src: A retail vendor who mis-formats an 856 gets a chargeback, not an email.
segments.tr: Um fornecedor de varejo que formata mal um 856 recebe um estorno, não um e-mail.

segments.src: And all of it runs on one humble input: **the scan**.
segments.tr: E tudo isso roda sobre uma entrada simples: **a leitura**.

segments.src: Order (ERP) -> allocate -> pick & pack (WMS) -> label -> tender (TMS)
segments.tr: Order (ERP) -> allocate -> pick & pack (WMS) -> label -> tender (TMS)

segments.src: -> carrier scans -> status back to ERP -> invoice -> freight audit
segments.tr: -> carrier scans -> status back to ERP -> invoice -> freight audit

segments.src: **Barcodes** are the workhorse.
segments.tr: **Códigos de barras** são o cavalo de batalha.

segments.src: A UPC identifies the product; a GS1-128 label on a pallet carries an SSCC — an 18-digit serial number that acts as a "license plate" so one scan pulls up the entire contents of that pallet.
segments.tr: Um UPC identifica o produto; uma etiqueta GS1-128 em um palete carrega um SSCC, um número de série de 18 dígitos que funciona como uma "placa de licença", de modo que uma única leitura traz todo o conteúdo daquele palete.

segments.src: Barcodes are effectively free to print, but they need line of sight and one read at a time.
segments.tr: Códigos de barras são praticamente gratuitos para imprimir, mas exigem linha de visada e uma leitura por vez.

segments.src: **RFID** (in retail supply chains, usually passive UHF "RAIN" RFID) flips that.
segments.tr: **RFID** (nas cadeias de suprimento de varejo, geralmente RFID UHF passivo "RAIN") inverte isso.

segments.src: A reader can pick up hundreds of tags at once, through a cardboard box, without anyone aiming anything.
segments.tr: Um leitor consegue captar centenas de etiquetas de uma vez, através de uma caixa de papelão, sem que ninguém precise apontar nada.

segments.src: Walk a handheld down a store aisle and count the inventory in minutes instead of hours.
segments.tr: Passe um leitor portátil por um corredor da loja e conte o estoque em minutos em vez de horas.

segments.src: The tradeoff is cost and physics: tags cost a few cents each at volume rather than nothing, and radio waves behave badly around metal and liquid.
segments.tr: O compromisso é custo e física: as etiquetas custam alguns centavos cada em grande volume, em vez de nada, e as ondas de rádio se comportam mal perto de metal e líquidos.

segments.src: That's why RFID took off first in apparel — light, non-metallic, high SKU count, and painful to count by hand — and why Walmart's expansion of its RFID tagging requirements beyond apparel starting in 2022 pushed a lot of suppliers into it.
segments.tr: Por isso o RFID decolou primeiro no vestuário (leve, não metálico, com muitos SKUs e doloroso de contar à mão), e por que a expansão, a partir de 2022, dos requisitos de etiquetagem RFID da Walmart além do vestuário empurrou muitos fornecedores para a tecnologia.

segments.src: The unglamorous truth: none of this fixes bad data.
segments.tr: A verdade pouco glamourosa: nada disso corrige dados ruins.

segments.src: If a receiver scans a pallet into the wrong bin, the WMS confidently tells a picker to walk to an empty shelf.
segments.tr: Se um recebedor lê um palete e o registra no compartimento errado, o WMS confiante manda um separador caminhar até uma prateleira vazia.

segments.src: Garbage in, expensive walk out.
segments.tr: Entrada ruim, caminhada cara.

segments.src: ## In Everyday Life
segments.tr: ## No dia a dia

segments.src: It's 11 p.m.
segments.tr: São 23h

segments.src: in Columbus, Ohio, and you order a $110 pair of running shoes with free two-day shipping.
segments.tr: em Columbus, Ohio, e você pede um tênis de corrida de US$ 110 com frete grátis em dois dias.

segments.src: The retailer's **ERP** captures the order and the payment.
segments.tr: O **ERP** do varejista registra o pedido e o pagamento.

segments.src: Available-to-promise logic checks inventory and assigns it to a fulfillment center in Indiana rather than the one in Nevada — closer to you, cheaper to ship, and the shoes are actually there.
segments.tr: A lógica de ATP (available-to-promise) verifica o estoque e atribui o pedido a um centro de atendimento em Indiana, e não ao de Nevada: mais perto de você, mais barato de enviar, e o tênis de fato está lá.

segments.src: The **WMS** drops a pick task onto a handheld.
segments.tr: O **WMS** envia uma tarefa de separação para um coletor portátil.

segments.src: A picker walks a route the system optimized, scans the shelf barcode (confirming the right location), scans the shoe box (confirming the right SKU), and drops it in a tote.
segments.tr: O separador percorre uma rota otimizada pelo sistema, lê o código de barras da prateleira (confirmando a posição certa), lê a caixa do tênis (confirmando o SKU certo) e a coloca em uma caixa-tote.

segments.src: Packing scans it again into a carton and prints a label.
segments.tr: A embalagem lê tudo de novo ao colocar na caixa de papelão e imprime uma etiqueta.

segments.src: Every one of those scans is the system asking "prove it" — that's how inventory records stay honest.
segments.tr: Cada uma dessas leituras é o sistema perguntando "prove": é assim que os registros de estoque permanecem confiáveis.

segments.src: The **TMS** — or the parcel-rating engine that plays its role — compares carriers and service levels for that ZIP code, picks one, and transmits the shipment data before the box is even on the trailer.
segments.tr: O **TMS**, ou o mecanismo de tarifação de encomendas que desempenha esse papel, compara transportadoras e níveis de serviço para aquele CEP, escolhe uma e transmite os dados do envio antes mesmo de a caixa estar no caminhão.

segments.src: That's why your tracking number goes live with "label created" while the box is still sitting in Indiana.
segments.tr: Por isso o seu número de rastreamento fica ativo com "etiqueta criada" enquanto a caixa ainda está em Indiana.

segments.src: Overnight the trailer runs to a sort hub — Memphis, Louisville, wherever the network routes it.
segments.tr: Durante a noite, o caminhão segue para um centro de triagem (Memphis, Louisville, onde a rede o direcionar).

segments.src: Each scan there is a status message flowing back upstream, which is what refreshes the tracking page you check at breakfast.
segments.tr: Cada leitura ali é uma mensagem de status que volta para a origem, e é isso que atualiza a página de rastreamento que você consulta no café da manhã.

segments.src: Two days later it's on your porch.
segments.tr: Dois dias depois, está na sua porta.

segments.src: You saw six tracking updates.
segments.tr: Você viu seis atualizações de rastreamento.

segments.src: The systems exchanged roughly fifty messages, and any one of them going quiet is what turns "out for delivery" into a support ticket.
segments.tr: Os sistemas trocaram cerca de cinquenta mensagens, e basta uma delas ficar muda para que "saiu para entrega" vire um chamado de suporte.

segments.src: ## Three-Line Recap
segments.tr: ## Resumo em três linhas

segments.src: 1. Logistics runs on three cooperating systems: ERP (the order and the books), WMS (inside the warehouse), TMS (freight and carriers).
segments.tr: 1. A logística funciona com três sistemas que cooperam: ERP (o pedido e os livros), WMS (dentro do armazém) e TMS (fretes e transportadoras).

segments.src: 2. They talk through EDI transaction sets or APIs, and the integration seams — not the individual systems — are where most projects fail.
segments.tr: 2. Eles conversam por meio de conjuntos de transações EDI ou APIs, e as junções de integração, não os sistemas individuais, são onde a maioria dos projetos falha.

segments.src: 3. Barcodes and RFID are the data-capture layer; without accurate scans, every system downstream is confidently wrong.
segments.tr: 3. Códigos de barras e RFID são a camada de captura de dados; sem leituras precisas, todos os sistemas a jusante ficam confiantemente errados.

segments.src: ## ✅ Self-Quiz
segments.tr: ## ✅ Autoavaliação

segments.src: **1.** A distribution center needs to decide which bin to store an incoming pallet in, and which pick path a worker should walk.
segments.tr: **1.** Um centro de distribuição precisa decidir em qual posição guardar um palete que chega e por qual percurso de separação um trabalhador deve andar.

segments.src: Which system handles this?
segments.tr: Qual sistema cuida disso?

segments.src: - A) ERP
segments.tr: - A) ERP

segments.src: - B) WMS
segments.tr: - B) WMS

segments.src: - C) TMS
segments.tr: - C) TMS

segments.src: - D) EDI
segments.tr: - D) EDI

segments.src: **2.** True or False: The main advantage of RFID over barcodes is that RFID tags are cheaper per unit.
segments.tr: **2.** Verdadeiro ou falso: a principal vantagem do RFID sobre códigos de barras é que as etiquetas RFID são mais baratas por unidade.

segments.src: **3.** Your company is overpaying carriers because nobody checks freight invoices against contracted rates.
segments.tr: **3.** Sua empresa paga a mais às transportadoras porque ninguém confere as faturas de frete com as tarifas contratadas.

segments.src: Which capability addresses this most directly?
segments.tr: Qual recurso resolve isso de forma mais direta?

segments.src: - A) Cycle counting in the WMS
segments.tr: - A) Contagem cíclica no WMS

segments.src: - B) Freight audit and pay in the TMS
segments.tr: - B) Auditoria e pagamento de frete no TMS

segments.src: - C) The item master in the ERP
segments.tr: - C) O cadastro de itens no ERP

segments.src: - D) SSCC license plate labels
segments.tr: - D) Etiquetas de placa de licença SSCC

segments.src: ## 📚 Today's Terms
segments.tr: ## 📚 Termos de hoje

segments.src: - **WMS (Warehouse Management System):** Software that directs work inside the warehouse — receiving, putaway, slotting, picking, packing, and cycle counting.
segments.tr: - **WMS (Warehouse Management System):** Software que direciona o trabalho dentro do armazém: recebimento, armazenagem (putaway), slotting, separação, embalagem e contagem cíclica.

segments.src: - **TMS (Transportation Management System):** Software that selects carriers and modes, consolidates and tenders loads, tracks freight, and audits carrier invoices.
segments.tr: - **TMS (Transportation Management System):** Software que seleciona transportadoras e modais, consolida e oferece cargas, acompanha fretes e audita faturas de transportadoras.

segments.src: - **ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning):** The company-wide system of record for orders, purchasing, item master data, and finance — the source WMS and TMS take direction from.
segments.tr: - **ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning):** O sistema de registro de toda a empresa para pedidos, compras, dados mestres de itens e finanças, a fonte de onde WMS e TMS recebem instruções.

segments.src: - **EDI (Electronic Data Interchange):** Standardized business documents exchanged machine-to-machine (e.g., 856 advance ship notice, 214 shipment status), still the backbone of U.S. retail supply chains.
segments.tr: - **EDI (Electronic Data Interchange):** Documentos comerciais padronizados trocados de máquina para máquina (ex.: 856 aviso prévio de expedição, 214 status de envio), ainda a espinha dorsal das cadeias de suprimento de varejo dos EUA.

segments.src: - **SSCC / license plate:** An 18-digit serial number in a GS1-128 barcode on a pallet or carton, letting one scan retrieve everything that unit contains.
segments.tr: - **SSCC / placa de licença:** Um número de série de 18 dígitos em um código de barras GS1-128 em um palete ou caixa, permitindo que uma única leitura recupere tudo o que aquela unidade contém.

segments.src: *Answers: **1 — B.** The WMS owns everything inside the four walls, including slotting and pick-path logic; the ERP holds the order, not the bin location.
segments.tr: *Respostas: **1 — B.** O WMS controla tudo dentro das quatro paredes, incluindo a lógica de slotting e de percurso de separação; o ERP guarda o pedido, não a posição do compartimento.

segments.src: **2 — False.** RFID tags cost more than a printed barcode; the real advantage is bulk, no-line-of-sight reading — hundreds of tags at once, through packaging.
segments.tr: **2 — Falso.** Etiquetas RFID custam mais do que um código de barras impresso; a verdadeira vantagem é a leitura em massa, sem linha de visada: centenas de etiquetas de uma vez, através da embalagem.

segments.src: **3 — B.** Freight audit and pay is a core TMS function, and recovering billing errors is often how a TMS pays for itself.*
segments.tr: **3 — B.** Auditoria e pagamento de frete é uma função central do TMS, e a recuperação de erros de cobrança costuma ser como um TMS se paga.*
